notes.note: Restriction tested statically: module-level constant str2oct("1G") is evaluated at compile time and must be rejected; the runtime error case is covered by C.01.28_test_007.
Text says 'even number', but the example str2oct("1D7") = '01D7'O shows that odd is meant; the odd-length reading is tested.
Reading chosen: for even input the length is exactly half; for odd input it is half rounded up (because of the 0 padding).
General error causes of 16.1.2 tested by one representative: actual parameter of wrong type (hexstring).
Restriction tested statically: module-level constant str2float("1,5") is evaluated at compile time and must be rejected; the runtime error case is covered by C.01.29_test_009.
Permission reading chosen (digits after the dot may be omitted), as in the example "+001.".
'typed object' read as an enumerated value with a type context; a bare enumerated identifier passed to enum2int has no type context and must be rejected.
